newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ambuja started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ambuja started as buy.

text.p: -- Caspian Securities said it started coverage on Monday of India's Gujarat Ambuja Cements Ltd with a buy rating at 277 rupees a share.

-- "Although GAC is exposed to the northern India market where cement prices are weakening, its coverage elsewhere, its high efficiency levels and its new plants will combine to produce impressive forecast average earnings growth of 31.8 percent over the next two years," analyst Ajay Malpini wrote in a report.
-- The firm set a 12-month price target of 360 rupees.
